title: Panel persistent actionable conversations and separate backup routine

needs: Keep settled conversations reachable and prevent accidental topic switches.
Allow the owner to operate Crow from chat and observe its runs.
Separate expensive backups from tool updates.
context: Cause spans topic persistence, selection, run registry and action policy; requires a workflow chain under ADR 030.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Settling a row preserves its topic and history; completed rows and global search reopen conversations, including existing stored topics.
AC2: Chat stays pinned across list navigation and settling; the topic banner is visible and the composer regains focus after answers without firing row shortcuts.
AC3: Live Claude chats can use Crow actions, files, jobs and classic Outlook reply-all drafts; sending mail remains forbidden and trial chats remain read-only.
AC4: Chat runs have readable topic labels and reopen links in Runs and Jobs, with fresh data after chat launches and completions.
AC5: New free-title or dossier chats and recent persisted conversations are accessible.
AC6: Machine updates and OneDrive backup have separate routines; the private script has backed-up no-backup and backup-only modes.
AC7: Hub handoff regression is fixed or documented with validation; tests pass, local commits exist and the live server is restarted.

product.title: Panel conversation continuity and actions
product.overview: Operate Crow through persistent topic chats with visible runs and independent maintenance routines.
goals: Preserve conversation identity and owner intent.
Make requested actions available without sending mail.
non_goals: Pushing or merging the panel branch

plan: 1. Preserve settled topics, pin chat and restore focus; add creation, recents and search.
2. Enable live Crow actions, expose existing draft pipeline and improve run visibility.
